items.author: foragingwords.bsky.social
items.context: has anyone ever completed a joja run in stardew? every time i try i get bored so fast
items.text: Joja runs can feel flat without the bundle goal to chase. Setting your own mini-challenge, like a themed farm, might keep it interesting.

items.author: abracapocus.bsky.social
items.context:
Why did I let myself get sucked back in to playing Stardew Valley? I forgot how addicting it is.
image: A screenshot of the Stardrop Saloon from the game Stardew Valley.
items.text: That 'just one more day' loop is real. Hope the farm is treating you well this time!
